title: AI for Sales and Product Consulting

questions.question: What is the main risk of AI-generated customer-facing material?
options: It can invent context, overstate value, or weaken trust if unchecked
questions.explanation: Customer-facing outputs need source checks and review.

questions.question: Which signal is explicitly part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Customer signal is a preparation and evidence signal.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked sales/product consulting AI plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact helps choose controls before customer material is used.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
When should customer-facing AI material require stronger controls?
options: When proposal risk, weak customer evidence, or high impact is present
Only when the document is internal
Only when no customer is involved
questions.explanation: Customer-facing material needs stronger controls when risk or impact is high.

questions.question: What should AI improve in sales and product consulting?
options: Preparation, value-story clarity, and follow-up discipline
questions.explanation: The lesson focuses on better preparation and trusted follow-up.
